comparison: Strict greater-than, upright 3D oriented IoU. All five arms on the identical roster. A missing 3D prediction yields IoU zero for each affected arm and stays in the denominator.
aggregation: Three target platforms equally weighted for the headline, and actual-pool mean and per-platform means as additional views. Every recording and every anonymous description exported.

descriptive_strata.category: Original target annotation class after prediction seal
descriptive_strata.definition: Distance is Euclidean norm of the target 3D center in the raw LiDAR frame. Count distinct valid annotated 3D boxes in the same view. These measure available annotations.

bootstrap: Paired per-recording resampling within platform, 4000 draws, seed 20261121. Also report per-platform intervals and all recording outcomes. These describe uncertainty on the previously used recordings.
primary_target_labels_access: After full Qwen and geometry seals
